definitions: To succeed in reaching a place or destination, especially despite difficulties.
To succeed in a career or endeavor.
To be able to attend an event or appointment.
To survive a difficult or dangerous situation.
To arrive in time for something.
examples: We made it to the top of the mountain.
She really made it big in Hollywood.
I hope you can make it to the party.
He was badly injured, but he made it.
Can you make it by 5 o'clock?
